# Tables

Every table is Parquet under `data/tables/<table>/` (partitioned tables use `<key>=<value>/` folders) and is readable with DuckDB or Polars. Use the dashboard's Tables page, or `bots tables list | show | export`. Each table has one owner bot; nothing else writes it.

| Table | Owner | Partition | Writes | What it holds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`bars_1m`](#bars_1m) | tables | date | append | One-minute OHLCV candles built from every tick |
| [`quotes_latest`](#quotes_latest) | tables | - | replace | Latest quote per instrument (rewritten every few seconds) |
| [`positions`](#positions) | tables | date | replace | Latest broker positions snapshot of the day |
| [`holdings`](#holdings) | tables | date | replace | Latest demat holdings snapshot of the day |
| [`funds`](#funds) | tables | date | append | Fund-limit snapshots |
| [`orders`](#orders) | tables | date | replace | Latest broker order book of the day |
| [`trades`](#trades) | tables | date | replace | Executed trades with per-trade charges |
| [`ledger`](#ledger) | tables | date | replace | Account ledger vouchers (funds in/out, charges, settlements) |
| [`exec_orders`](#exec_orders) | tables | date | replace | Orders placed by the execution bot (dhan_bot engine) |
| [`exec_fills`](#exec_fills) | tables | date | append | Fills of execution-bot orders |
| [`candles_daily`](#candles_daily) | tables | symbol | replace | Daily OHLCV history per symbol |
| [`history_metrics`](#history_metrics) | history | - | replace | Per-stock trend metrics as of the latest daily close |
| [`monthly_returns`](#monthly_returns) | history | - | replace | Month-by-month returns per symbol (seasonality) |
| [`correlations`](#correlations) | history | - | replace | Correlation of daily returns between watchlist symbols (1y) |
| [`money_allocation`](#money_allocation) | money | - | replace | Where the money is: invested vs current value by platform and stock |
| [`money_pnl`](#money_pnl) | money | - | replace | Realised P&L by day and stock (from trades) plus unrealised by stock |
| [`money_charges`](#money_charges) | money | - | replace | Charges by type, platform, stock and month |
| [`money_cashflows`](#money_cashflows) | money | - | replace | Funds added / withdrawn by month |
| [`money_expenses`](#money_expenses) | money | - | replace | Spending outside trades: subscriptions, servers, AI API, manual entries |
| [`money_summary`](#money_summary) | money | - | replace | Headline money numbers |
| [`ai_costs`](#ai_costs) | ai_analyst | date | append | Every Claude API call: tokens and cost |

## bars_1m

One-minute OHLCV candles built from every tick. Owner: **tables** bot; partitioned by `date`; append writes.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | String | trading symbol |
| `segment` | String | exchange segment |
| `security_id` | Int64 | Dhan security id |
| `tf` | Int64 | timeframe in seconds |
| `start_ts` | Float64 | candle open time |
| `open` | Float64 |  |
| `high` | Float64 |  |
| `low` | Float64 |  |
| `close` | Float64 |  |
| `volume` | Int64 | traded volume in the candle (0 for indices) |
